name: dp-it-prassi-convert
description: Converts grabbed prassi PDFs (AdE portal, DocTrib interpelli) into <stem>.plan.json load plans: estremi, text (PDF text layer or local OCR), norm references. Writes files only.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read the grab output from dirIn and write <stem>.plan.json into dirOut. A document that cannot be read is recorded as skipped with a reason; the item still ends ok.

items.description: the items to convert, as reported by the detect step

output.description: { dirOut, converted: [{key, plan, meta}], metrics: {documents, ocr, skipped, warnings} }
